prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Edit target: image 1 is the current Clash Remote macOS application screenshot. Completely redesign its entire interface for the direction below, rather than copying its current arrangement. Image 2 is the original app logo and must be preserved exactly: dark navy rounded-square icon containing a pale mint sitting cat with curled tail. Do not redesign or replace this logo.
Deliverable: ONE high fidelity full-window desktop app UI design mockup, straight-on screenshot view, landscape 5:4 proportions matching 2200×1744. No photograph, laptop bezel, hands, advertising poster, comparison collage, watermark, or external presentation border. Show a single complete macOS window with small traffic-light controls and a discreet toolbar. All of the actual dashboard content should fit within one window without a truncated bottom.
Information and functional content to retain: left sidebar with old cat logo and product name "Clash Remote"; Chinese navigation "总览", "节点", "订阅", "规则", "设备控制", "本地配置". Two router entries "Rax3000M" with "192.168.10.1" and "ZTE U30Pro" with "192.168.0.1:2333". Active router Rax3000M. Current proxy node "新加坡 01", latency "161 ms". Proxy running, control labeled "停止代理", node action "切换节点". Compact mode selector "规则", "全局", "直连" with 规则 selected. Useful traffic metrics: "下载速率" value "8.42 MB/s", "上传速率" value "246 KB/s", "活动连接" value "180", "核心内存" value "64.2 MB". Router guard panel "设备守护", status "等待启动", action "管理守护".
Only actual brand/model names and technical units may be English. No decorative English text: NEVER add LIVE OVERVIEW, NETWORK CONTROL, WORKSPACE, ROUTERS, DASHBOARD, or slogans. Chinese text must be crisp, legible, correctly spelled. Do not repeatedly state that the device is connected. Avoid the existing huge blue gradient hero banner and the existing sparse rows of oversized cards. Build a coherent professional native macOS app, using aligned grids, carefully proportioned controls, readable typography, compact chrome, useful diagrams/charts and distinctive visual hierarchy.
Direction A — refined LIGHT dashboard:
Cool off-white canvas, clean white panels with delicate gray outlines, navy typography and restrained mint/blue accents. Visually sophisticated and practical. Sidebar slim at roughly 19% width, subtle blue-gray translucent appearance. Header contains only "总览", active router identification and a single small green running badge. A wide left main panel contains a beautiful realtime upload/download area-line chart, Chinese label "流量趋势", subtle axes and one fine cyan line and one muted blue line. The right main panel is an action-focused route card, compact router-to-node diagram, current node, latency, clear power control and node switch. Beneath the chart arrange four compact numeric metrics in a continuous instrument strip. Lower row has a compact mode selector on left and guard status/settings on right. Small rounded corners, gentle depth, strong contrast, generous breathing room without wasting space. No large illustration. This should look like a carefully finished premium desktop utility, not a website landing page.

Direction B — graphite DARK control console:
This design must be clearly different from direction A and from the reference. Rich charcoal window and sidebar, black-blue panels with restrained hairline borders, pale neutral text, selective luminous jade/cyan accent. No harsh neon, rainbow gradients or gaming aesthetics. Header is a tight horizontal device strip with router name, IP and a single green service state. Across the top of main area show four metrics with large numerals integrated in one band, NOT four oversized separate boxes. The dominant lower-left workspace displays realtime upload and download chart, fine grid and turquoise/soft-blue curves, with Chinese graph labels. The fixed right action column contains the current route with a small horizontal network topology, "新加坡 01", "161 ms", a clear compact power control and "切换节点", three-way segmented mode selector, and guard controls. Bottom-left contains a concise connection health / device summary with small meaningful icons. Mature precision instrument mood, crisp high contrast typography, fine subtle glow only on active network path. Old navy/mint cat logo preserved exactly and visible on sidebar. No large blue hero banner.

Direction C — warm LIGHT cat-themed mature desktop app:
Warm ivory canvas with desaturated sage, pale mint, navy text and a small soft apricot accent. A distinctive compact modular composition, not a reskin of the reference and not a dashboard clone. Sidebar very light warm-gray with original navy/mint cat logo. Top header "总览" and discreet router status. At upper-left make an action-oriented connection card with current router, current node, 161 ms latency and compact "停止代理" and "切换节点" controls; include a tasteful minimalist line illustration based on the same sitting-cat silhouette from image 2, near a tiny router and smooth network path. This secondary motif does NOT replace or distort the original logo. At upper-right a neat realtime traffic trend panel with mint and apricot curves. Center a continuous white four-metric strip. Bottom row: elegant wide segmented "规则 / 全局 / 直连" card and compact "设备守护" card. Add faint curved route-line patterns and one small cat silhouette accent within the connection artwork only; no repeated cat wallpapers, giant mascot, cartoon toy look, fake 3D objects, or ornamental clutter. Gentle tactile texture, precise layout, polished product character, friendly yet fully grown-up.
